claim: After a history rewrite, decide whether a stale branch has commits missing from main by per-commit triage, never by ahead/behind or merge-base: a read-only git merge-tree 3-way against main, line containment of the added lines in main current copy (or its relocated path), then residual classification (moved, deleted on purpose, never landed). Replay only never-landed deltas, by integrative-merge mode.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-23 orama audit: 13 patch-unique commits carried by 53 branches were all absorbed, relocated, or deliberately superseded, and 0 of 36 residual files were absent from main history. Another agent plan used ahead/behind figures (about 90 versus 1864 behind) that are invalid across the rewrite. Script and procedure: semantic/REANCHOR_TRIAGE_MECHANICS_2026-10-23.md.
